rank.1: Cannot be Summoned by normal means — only by shattering a barrier no monster has broken before. Once on the field, it cannot be targeted, negated, or dethroned. Its record is permanent.
rank.2: Needs no Tribute, only relentless practice. Its ATK/DEF always equal the highest score of the current Era. While on the field, all 'Second Place' effects are negated.
rank.3: Gains 1 Level per consecutive year in the Top 10. Once per Duel: skip your Draw Phase to solve 3 problems instead — if you do, this card's ATK doubles.
rank.4: Cannot be destroyed by a lower-Rated monster. Once per turn: discard 1 card to cancel a rating drop and restore this card's Peak ATK.
rank.5: If this card wins a Duel, it gains 100 ATK permanently. This increase cannot be removed by any effect, not even its own controller's.
rank.6: Once per turn: Tribute 1 'Contest' Spell to draw 3 cards, keep 1. This card ignores all 'Div. 3 or lower' effects.
rank.7: When this card would take battle damage, reveal 1 solution instead. Its DEF can never fall below its ATK.
rank.8: Gains a Milestone Counter each time it's Summoned. +200 ATK per counter. Cannot be Tributed for a lower-Rank Summon.
rank.9: Its activation cannot be responded to during Contest Phase. Once per turn: view your opponent's hand and negate 1 approach.
rank.10: While in the Top 10, immune to 'Rank Decay.' If it would drop out, you may banish it instead to keep its record intact.

contribution.3: Once per turn: reveal 1 Editorial to Summon a 'Grateful Newbie' Token. Banish it to negate 1 'This is trivial' comment.
contribution.4: Its Contribution can never drop below 0. Once per turn: pay 500 Karma to add 'Well-Written Problem' to your hand.
contribution.5: Negates and destroys any card that copies this card's effect without credit. Gains 300 ATK on your opponent's turn.
contribution.6: Once per turn, even on your opponent's turn: target 1 'Confused Newbie' Token and set its ATK equal to this card's.
contribution.7: Immune to 'Thread Necro.' Once per turn: send 1 old Blog from your GY to your hand instead of drawing.
contribution.8: Immune to 'Low Engagement.' Once per turn: banish 1 card from your GY to gain 100 Karma, even off-field.
contribution.9: Once per turn: discard 1 card to give your opponent a 'Helpful Reply' Token. While it exists, 'Toxicity' effects are negated.
contribution.10: Gains 1 Karma Counter each Standby Phase. Cannot be destroyed by battle while holding 5 or more.

legends.mikemirzayanov: Not a Monster — this card IS the Field itself. Every ruling and rating change exists only because it allows it. Cannot be destroyed, negated, or removed. Its text overrides all others.
legends.petr: On the field since before any current player joined. Its stats predate a rating system that no longer exists in its original form. Immune to 'Power Creep.' Still wins.
legends.errichto: Once per turn: reveal 1 low-ATK monster in hand and explain its effect aloud to Special Summon it, gaining 500 ATK. Countless monsters worldwide were taught to fight by this card.
legends.um_nik: Effect: 'No.' That is the entire text of this card. It has never needed to be longer.
legends.secondthread: Once per turn, either player's turn: reveal your opponent's entire hand aloud. They cannot prevent it — thousands already know before their next move.
